metadata.title: ORCHID calculated binary phase diagrams
metadata.description:
ORCHID calculated binary phase diagrams: binary phase diagrams calculated with pycalphad 0.11.2 from the SGTE binary collection (Hallstedt 2025, CC BY 4.0), each tied to the exact TDB file by SHA-256 and to the original assessment it encodes (citation and DOI from the TDB header). Part of the ORCHID data release v2026.10.

What

  • 2,774 SGTE binary databases: 2,720 calculated, 54 failed (recorded with status failed).
  • Per diagram (phase-diagrams/sgte/<TDB>.json): phase-region boundaries, 24,828 invariant equilibria with temperatures, phases and phase compositions over all diagrams, an equilibrium phase grid, temperature range, TDB SHA-256, original-assessment citation and DOI.
  • phase-diagrams/index.json lists diagrams per system; Parquet tables phase_diagram_index and phase_diagram_invariants.

How

pycalphad 0.11.2 BinaryStrategy mapping plus an equilibrium grid at 1 atm, run on every SGTE binary file of the ORCHID catalog (open-tdb).

Limitations

  • Calculated values are model results, not measurements, and are as good as the assessment and the calculation grid.
  • 54 files did not calculate; metastable and pressure-dependent features are not represented.

Licence

Derived data: CC BY 4.0. Third-party data keep their own licences and citations (NOTICE.md, LICENSES.md in the bundle): SGTE binary collection, Hallstedt 2025 (CC BY 4.0); Materials Project (CC BY 4.0); OQMD (CC BY 4.0).

Files: one zip (orchid-phase-diagrams-v2026.10.zip) holding the files at their repository paths, a MANIFEST.sha256, the README, CHANGELOG and licence files. Its file list with sizes and SHA-256 is zenodo/phase-diagrams.files.json in the data repository.

How to cite

R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID calculated binary phase diagrams (version 2026.10), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-phase-diagrams

Part of: R. Arróyave, J. Saal, D. Shin, ORCHID data (version 2026.10; Version 1, machine-extracted), Zenodo (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.PENDING-orchid-data

Also cite B. Hallstedt, The SGTE collection of binary datasets, Calphad 89 (2025) 102833, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.calphad.2025.102833 (CC BY 4.0), and the original assessment named in each file.
